Bank Math Master.question: ১) If the difference between the circumference and diameter of a circle is 90 cm, then the diameter of the circle is -
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If the difference between the circumference and diameter of a circle is 90 cm, then the diameter of the circle is -

Solution:
ধরি,
বৃত্তের ব্যাসার্ধ = r
বৃত্তের ব্যাস = 2r
বৃত্তের পরিধি = 2πr

প্রশ্নমতে,
2πr - 2r = 90
⇒ 2r(π - 1) = 90
⇒ r = (90/2){(22/7) - 1}
⇒ r = 45/(22 - 7)/7
⇒ r = (45 × 7)/15
∴ r = 21

∴ বৃত্তের ব্যাস = 2r = 2 × 21 = 42 সে.মি.

Bank Math Master.question: ২) If the one third of one fourth of a number is 15, then what is the 3/10 of the number?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If the one third of one fourth of a number is 15, then what is the 3/10 of the number?

Solution:
Let the number be x

ATQ,
(1/3) × (1/4) × x = 15
⇒ 1/12 × x = 15
x = 180

Now,
3x/10 = (3/10) × 180
∴ 3x/10 = 54

Bank Math Master.question: ৩) A, B and C are partners of a company. During a particular year A received one-third of the profit, B received one-fourth of the profit and C received the remaining Tk. 5000. How much did B receive?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A, B and C are partners of a company. During a particular year A received one-third of the profit, B received one-fourth of the profit and C received the remaining Tk. 5000. How much did B receive?

Solution:
ধরি,
মোট লাভ = x টাকা

প্রশ্নমতে,
x - (x/3 + x/4) = 5000
⇒ x - (4x + 3x)/12 = 5000
⇒ x - 7x/12 = 5000
⇒ (12x - 7x)/12 = 5000
⇒ 5x/12 = 5000
⇒ 5x = 5000 × 12
⇒ x = (5000 × 12)/5
∴ x = 12000

∴ B পায় = (12000 × 1/4) টাকা = 3000 টাকা

Bank Math Master.question: ৭) The sum of the ages of a daughter and her mother is 56 years. After four years, the age of the mother will be three times that of the daughter. What is the present age of mother is -

Question: The sum of the ages of a daughter and her mother is 56 years. After four years, the age of the mother will be three times that of the daughter. What is the present age of mother is -

Solution:
ধরি,

Bank Math Master.question: ৮) How many terms of Arithmetic Progression 21, 18, 15, 12 ............. must be taken to give the sum zero?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: How many terms of Arithmetic Progression 21, 18, 15, 12 ............. must be taken to give the sum zero?

Solution:
এখানে,
21, 18, 15, 12, ..................
১ম পদ, a = 21
সাধারণ অন্তর, d = 18 - 21 = - 3

আমরা জানি,
n সংখ্যক পদের সমষ্টি = (n/2){2a + (n - 1)d}

প্রশ্নমতে,
(n/2){2a + (n - 1)d} = 0
⇒ (n/2){2 × 21 + (n - 1)(- 3)} = 0
⇒ (n/2)(42 - 3n + 3) = 0
⇒ n(45 - 3n) = 0
⇒ 45n - 3n2 = 0
⇒ 3n(n - 15) = 0
⇒ n - 15 = 0
∴ n = 15

Bank Math Master.question: ৯) Having scored 98 runs in the 19th innings a cricketer increase his average score by 4.what will be his average score after the 19th innings?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: Having scored 98 runs in the 19th innings a cricketer increase his average score by 4.what will be his average score after the 19th innings?

Solution:
Let, his average score is x
His total score after 19th innings = 19x

ATQ,
(19x - 98)/18 = x - 4
⇒ 19x - 98 = 18x - 72
⇒ 19x - 18x = 98 - 72
∴ x = 26

His average score is 26

Bank Math Master.question: ১০) A tank is 30% full with water. If 18 liters of water is added the tank become 3/4 full. What is the capacity of the tank?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A tank is 30% full with water. If 18 liters of water is added the tank become 3/4 full. What is the capacity of the tank?

Solution:
Let, Capacity of tank is x Liters.

ATQ,
30% of x + 18 = (3/4) × x
⇒ (30x/100) + 18 = 3x/4
⇒ (3x/10) + 18 = 3x/4
⇒ (3x/4) - (3x/10) = 18
⇒ (15x - 6x)/20 = 18
⇒ 9x = 18 × 20
⇒ 9x = 360
∴ x = 40

∴ Capacity of tank is 40 Liters.

Bank Math Master.question: ১১) The difference of two numbers is 12. If 1 is added to the greater number, it becomes twice the smaller number. Calculate the two numbers?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: The difference of two numbers is 12. If 1 is added to the greater number, it becomes twice the smaller number. Calculate the two numbers?

Solution:
ধরি,
বড় সংখ্যাটি = x
ছোট সংখ্যাটি = y

১ম শর্তমতে,
x - y = 12 ............................. (1)

২য় শর্তমতে,
x + 1 = 2y ............................. (2)

(1) নং হতে (2) নং সমীকরণ বিয়োগ করে পাই,
x - y - x - 1 = 12 - 2y
বা, - y = - 13
∴ y = 13

(1) নং হতে পাই,
x - 13 = 12
বা, x = 12 + 13
∴ x = 25

∴ সংখ্যা দুটি 25 ও 13

Bank Math Master.question: ১২) A man can row at the rate of 4 km/hr in still water. If the time taken to row a certain distance upstream is 3 times as much as to row the same distance downstream, find the speed of the current?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A man can row at the rate of 4 km/hr in still water. If the time taken to row a certain distance upstream is 3 times as much as to row the same distance downstream, find the speed of the current?

Solution:
Let,
speed of stream x
Time taken in downstream = t
Time taken in downstream = 3t

ATQ.
Distance in upstream = Distance in downstream
(4 - x)3t = (4 + x)t
⇒ (4 - x)3 = (4 + x)
⇒ 12 - 3x = 4 + x
⇒ 4x = 8
∴ x = 2

∴ Speed of stream = 2 km/hr

Solution:
Sugar = 400 × 30% = 120 grams
Let,
We have to add x grams 

ATQ,
120 + x = 50% (400 + x)
⇒ 120 + x = (50/100) × (400 + x)
⇒ 120 + x = (1/2) × (400 + x)
⇒ 240 + 2x = 400 + x

Bank Math Master.question: ১৪) After paying 10 % tax on all income over 3000 Kawser had a net income of Tk 12000. Kawser's income before tax was.
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: After paying 10 % tax on all income over 3000 Kawser had a net income of Tk 12000. Kawser's income before tax was.

Solution:
Let Kawser income was x.
Taxable income = x - 3000
∴ Tax paid = 10%(x - 3000)

ATQ,
x - 10%(x - 3000) = 12000
⇒ x - {10(x - 3000)/100} = 12000
⇒ (10x - x + 3000)10 = 12000
⇒ 9x + 3000 = 120000
⇒ 9x = 120000 - 3000
⇒ 9x = 117000
⇒ x = 117000/9
∴ x = 13000

Kawser income was Tk.13000

Solution:

⇒ - 1 + 3 ≤ 4x - 3 + 3 ≤ 1 + 3

Bank Math Master.question: ২২) A committee of 5 members is to be formed by selecting out of 8 men and 6 women. In how many different ways the committee can be formed if it should have at least 4 men?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: A committee of 5 members is to be formed by selecting out of 8 men and 6 women. In how many different ways the committee can be formed if it should have at least 4 men? 

Solution:
      Men (8)       Women (6)
1)    4                     1
2)    5                     0

From (1) Number of ways = 8C4 × 6C1 = 70 × 6 = 420
From (2) Number of ways = 8C5 × 6C0 = 56 × 1 = 56

Total number of ways = 420 + 56 = 476

Bank Math Master.question: ২৩) If secθ + tanθ = x, then cotθ is -
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If secθ + tanθ = x, then cotθ is - 

Solution:
দেওয়া আছে,
secθ + tanθ = x ................. (1)

আমরা জানি,
sec2θ - tan2θ = 1
বা, (secθ + tanθ)(secθ - tanθ) = 1
বা, x(secθ - tanθ) = 1
বা, secθ - tanθ = 1/x ................ (2)

(1) - (2) হতে পাই,
(secθ + tanθ) - (secθ - tanθ) = x - (1/x)
বা, 2tanθ = (x2 - 1)/x
বা, tanθ = (x2 - 1)/2x
∴ cotθ = 2x/(x2 - 1)
